correctness.rationale: The order-four nonunital ring I2 has additive group (F2)^2 and squares 0^2=b^2=0, a^2=c^2=b. Any cardinality-2 additive code is exactly C_v={0,v} for unique v!=0; it is ACD iff <v,v>=(n_a+n_c)b is nonzero, i.e. odd n_a+n_c. Four-symbol coordinate multiplicities characterize permutation orbits. Fix distance d and odd j=n_a+n_c: there are j+1 splits of j between a,c with n_b=d-j, yielding sum over odd j of (j+1) and closed N_d. Sum over d proves even/odd total class formulas; exactly half of 4^n labeled vectors have odd contributing parity. Independent direct multiplication table, vector enumeration and orbits n=1..7 found classes 2,4,10,16,28,40,60 and labeled counts 2,8,32,128,512,2048,8192, matching closed formulas. This is a proof for every n, not an extrapolation.
